expected_behavior: When semantic construction of an action fails, the returned ModelError retains the action declaration span. An unknown action-parameter type on source line 4 must therefore report span.start.line == 4 instead of leaving span unset.
fix_patch:
diff --git a/rust/fsl-core/src/model.rs b/rust/fsl-core/src/model.rs
--- a/rust/fsl-core/src/model.rs
+++ b/rust/fsl-core/src/model.rs
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
                     actions.push(
                         self.action(name, params, items, *span, *fair, meta.clone())
-                            .map_err(|error| error.with_origin(origin))?,
+                            .map_err(|error| error.with_origin(origin).at(*span))?,
                     );
spec_queries: ModelError span action parameter semantic error
